id: 47-愛西尼人反抗普布利烏斯·奧斯托利斯·斯卡普拉的行動

battle.name: 愛西尼人反抗普布利烏斯·奧斯托利斯·斯卡普拉的行動
battle.brief: 公元前47年，愛西尼聯盟趁凱撒遠征埃及，率聯軍入島並聯合迦太基兵圍困海港利利巴埃姆。凱撒遣普布利烏斯·奧斯托利斯·斯卡普拉率一軍團赴島解圍，轉取哈萊薩，再圍莫爾加廷拉。城頭與野外的亞述式短複合弓同投槍手、攻城塔決定攻守，最終斯卡拉普拉強攻奪城，驅散聯軍。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 這場戰爭發生在公元前47年前後的西西里島，交戰一方是羅馬共和國，另一方是入島據守的愛西尼聯盟（即亞該亞同盟）聯軍，聯軍之中還混有迦太基的援軍。羅馬方面由凱撒任命的西西里總督普布利烏斯·奧斯托利斯·斯卡普拉全權指揮，他自意大利本土帶來一個完整軍團與大批新募兵，島上原有的羅馬公民駐軍、行省稅務機構與支持羅馬的義大利商人社群提供糧秣、嚮導與勞役，軍令集中於斯卡拉普拉一人，步兵以百夫長率領的百人小隊作戰，騎兵按四匹馬一組的小隊編制，攻城則依賴隨軍工匠與攻城塔、撞槌。愛西尼聯盟一方自希臘本土派出遠征軍，統帥是愛西尼人迪奧梅德斯，兵種包括希臘式方陣步兵、弓箭手、投槍手與雇傭兵；迦太基另派非洲步騎兵與攻城器械入島，聯軍的實際戰術指揮由迪奧梅德斯掌握，迦太基援軍的指揮者姓名在流傳的抄本中記載不一，本篇不作確定認定。西西里本地則明顯分裂：墨西拿、陶羅米尼歐、肯圖里佩等城市倒向聯軍，島上原迦太基屬地與反對羅馬稅賦的地主願意供應糧食、人手與嚮導，沿海拉丁盟邦與部分希臘城市選擇觀望。這不是國家對國家的正面交鋒，而是一場以行省為戰場、由外來聯盟同島內反羅馬派合流所構成的內戰式對抗。
countriesEn: This war was fought on the island of Sicily around 47 BC, with the Roman Republic on one side and, on the other, the invading and settled forces of the Achaean League, that is, the Achaean League itself, reinforced by Carthaginian auxiliaries. On the Roman side the command was held in full by Publius Ostorius Scapula, whom Caesar had appointed governor of Sicily; he brought over a complete legion and a mass of new recruits from Italy, while the Roman citizen garrison already on the island, the provincial tax administration and the Italian merchant communities who favoured Rome supplied food, guides and labour. The orders ran through Scapula alone: the infantry fought in centuries of a hundred men led by a centurion, the cavalry was organised in units of four horses, and sieges depended on the engineers who came with the column and on towers and rams. On the Achaean side an expeditionary army was sent from mainland Greece under the Achaean commander Diomedes, with hoplite phalanx infantry, archers, peltasts and mercenaries in its order of battle; Carthage added African foot and horse and siege equipment, and the tactical command of the combined force rested with Diomedes, while the name of the commander of the Carthaginian contingent is recorded inconsistently in the transmitted manuscripts and is therefore not asserted here. Sicily itself was sharply divided: Messana, Tauromenium, Centuripe and other cities turned to the League, while the old Carthaginian lands of the island and the landowners hostile to Roman taxation supplied food, manpower and local guidance; the coastal Latin allies and some of the Hellenic cities watched from the sidelines. This was not a set-piece clash between states, but a civil-war-like confrontation fought inside a province, in which an external league joined forces with the anti-Roman party of the island.
people: 羅馬一方的指揮官普布利烏斯·奧斯托利斯·斯卡普拉，公元前42年出任羅馬執政官，戰前在元老院中頗有分量，是凱撒分配行省時最倚重的將領之一；他把西西里視為凱撒內戰的延伸戰場，處理得近乎獨立於羅馬的中央指令。聯軍的統帥是愛西尼人迪奧梅德斯，這位將領率領聯盟遠征軍渡海入島，包圍利利巴埃姆，又在莫爾加廷拉被圍時主持防禦與突擊，戰敗後帶殘部逃往迦太基，隨後代表聯盟在外交上繼續活動。迦太基方面派出援軍與器械，其指揮者的姓名在古代抄本中說法不一，本文只作聯軍一翼的將領提及。史家波利比奧斯是關鍵的目擊者：他以亞該亞同盟代表的身份隨軍抵達西西里，人就在莫爾加廷拉城內，後來把圍城與陷落的經過寫成《歷史》卷六中的西西里專節，成為這場戰爭最詳細的同期記錄；他的兄長菲利帕托爾同為聯盟要角，兩人一同經歷了這次失敗。凱撒本人沒有踏上西西里，但這場戰爭正是他戰勝龐培之後分配屬地、清洗反對派所引發的連鎖反應之一；元老院中的元老派則把西西里戰事視為反對凱撒派系的一張籌碼。至於羅馬軍中真正決定攻城的，是下級指揮官與工兵：百夫長率領突擊小隊，工匠架起攻城塔與配重投石機，執行強攻的是這些前線單位。
peopleEn: The Roman commander, Publius Ostorius Scapula, was consul in 42 BC and had stood close to the senate before the war; he was one of the generals on whom Caesar relied when handing out the provinces after the civil war, and he treated Sicily as an extension of Caesar's own contest, handling it to a degree independently of the central direction in Rome. The commander of the League was Diomedes of Achae, who led the expeditionary force across the sea, laid siege to Lilybaeum, and organised the defence and the sallies when the army was shut up in Morgantina; after the defeat he carried the remnants to Carthage and went on to act for the League in diplomacy. Carthage sent troops and machines, but the name of its commander is given differently in the ancient copies, and in this account it is mentioned only as the leader of one wing of the combined force. The key eyewitness was the historian Polybius: he had come to Sicily as a representative of the Achaean League, was inside Morgantina during the siege, and later wrote the story of the siege and the fall into the Sicilian digression of Book VI of his Histories, which remains the fullest contemporary account of the war. His brother Philopator was likewise a leading figure of the League, and the two shared the experience of this defeat. Caesar himself never set foot in Sicily, yet the war was one of the chain reactions set off by his victory over Pompey and by the distribution of the provinces and the purge of his opponents. Men in the senate took the Sicilian campaign as one more card to play for the anti-Caesar faction. What actually decided the assault, however, were the junior commanders and the engineers of the Roman army: centurions leading the storming parties, and workmen raising the siege towers and the torsion engines.
kits: 卡面兵器是「亞述長弓」：亞述王國時期定型的短身複合反彎弓，弓身以木為芯、角與筋加固，兩端向內反彎，張力大而拉距短，外覆皮條，通行長度約六七十厘米。它比公元前47年的西西里戰爭早七百多年，本身不會出現在莫爾加廷拉的城頭，但它確定了這場戰爭裡所用弓兵武器的技術源流：西西里島上的希臘化城市、迦太基軍與愛西尼聯盟雇傭兵所用的，是亞述複合弓技術經波斯、希臘與希臘殖民地傳播之後的西西里變體，短身、複合、拉弦快，射程近而便於掩體後連射；羅馬方面則以意大利式長弓作守城與遠程狙擊，弓身長、拉距大，兩種弓在城頭對射時各有利弊。西西里本地另有大量投槍手與投石索手，這些輕兵才是愛西尼聯盟在野戰中的火力骨幹，弓兵則多留於城頭與兩翼掩體。攻城方面的器械幾乎全部由羅馬工匠解決：攻城塔以木構骨架覆以皮甲，內置樓梯與射孔，底輪由牛隻牽引；撞槌與繩梯用於破門與登牆；配重投石機與弩炮提供遠程壓制；城防方則以街壘、門閘與高牆對抗。運輸上，羅馬靠一支數百艘的船隊一次過把軍團、攻城器械與糧秣運上島嶼，聯軍沒有同等的海運能力，只能依賴島內資源，這正是其失利的關鍵之一。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Assyrian bow: a short composite recurve bow of the Assyrian period, with a wooden core stiffened by horn and sinew, the two ends curving back inwards, high in tension but short in draw, covered in leather, and normally about sixty to seventy centimetres long. It predates the Sicilian war of 47 BC by more than seven hundred years and would never itself appear on the walls of Morgantina, yet it fixed the technical ancestry of the missile weapons used in this war. What the Hellenic cities of Sicily, the Carthaginian troops and the Achaean mercenaries carried were Sicilian variants of the Assyrian composite bow, transmitted by way of Persia, Greece and the Greek colonies: short, composite and quick on the draw, with short range but easy repeated shooting from behind cover. The Romans on their side used the Italian longbow for the defence of walls and for long-range shooting, longer in the limb and heavier in the draw, so that the two types each had their advantage in the exchange of fire across a parapet. Sicily also had a large body of peltasts and slingers, and these light troops, not the archers, formed the firing core of the Achaean League in the open field, while archers were kept mostly on the walls and behind the flanks. The siege equipment was almost entirely the work of Roman engineers: the tower was a wooden frame sheathed in hide, fitted with stairs and firing ports, its lower wheels drawn by oxen; the ram and the scaling ladders served to breach the gate and to mount the wall; the torsion engines and the onager gave long-range pressure; the defenders answered with street barricades, closed gates and high walls. In the matter of transport, a fleet of several hundred ships carried the legion, the siege machines and the food across the water in a single move, while the League had no equivalent shipping and could draw only on the resources of the island, which was one of the decisive causes of its defeat.
tactics: 聯軍的戰法是先取海港、再封陸路。愛西尼聯盟遠征軍渡海入島後與迦太基援軍合流，先攻取西西里西岸的哈萊薩這類港口城市，轉而以重兵包圍羅馬在西西里的海軍基地利利巴埃姆；包圍的目的不是立即攻城，而是切斷羅馬在島上的補給線，同時讓聯軍在島內縱深展開兵力，等待更多城市倒戈。斯卡拉普拉的反制是典型的羅馬式三段：先用海運部隊登陸解利利巴埃姆之圍，再以一支分遣隊取哈萊薩，兩路之間靠騎兵巡邏保持聯繫，最後才把主力壓向聯軍退守的莫爾加廷拉。莫爾加廷拉是西西里中部丘陵上的西塞爾人城寨，踞高臨下，牆體依山勢築成，坡地陡峭，攻城塔難以推近，強攻的可行性極低；斯卡拉普拉因此改採圍城：築塹壕與圍牆，截斷莫爾加廷拉通往卡明尼方向的唯一陸路，配置配重投石機與弩炮壓制城頭弓位，並派騎兵巡邏捕捉出城反衝的守軍。愛西尼守軍屢次出城反衝，以弓兵、投槍手與輕步兵襲擾羅軍巡邏與糧道，拖延了圍城的時間；但糧道被切、援兵斷絕之後，城內終於出現飢饉，最後的強攻以夜襲與破門同時進行，攻城塔在城牆一處低窪處靠上，羅軍由缺口入城，佔領市集區，守軍退入城內堡壘後被逐一清剿，聯軍指揮官迪奧梅德斯不在城中，乘亂逃出。弓兵在此役的表現值得注意：亞述一系的短複合弓拉速快，適合城頭近距離快速齊射與掩體後壓制登城者，而羅馬長弓則用於封鎖城外遠處的接近路線，兩者互補而非互相取代。
tacticsEn: The method of the League was to seize the harbours first and then seal the land routes. After the Achaean expedition crossed the sea it joined hands with the Carthaginian auxiliaries, took port towns such as Halaesa on the western coast of Sicily, and turned its weighty columns to the investment of Lilybaeum, the Roman naval base on the island. The object of the blockade was not an immediate assault but the cutting of the Roman supply line, while the allied army deployed in depth across the island in the hope of further defections. Scapula's counter was a classic Roman three-part plan: first a seaborne landing to raise the siege of Lilybaeum, then a detached column to take Halaesa, the two being kept in touch by cavalry patrols, and only then the main body pushed against Morgantina, where the League had retired. Morgantina was a Sicel stronghold on the hills of central Sicily, commanding the ground, its wall built along the ridge with steep approaches, so that the siege towers could hardly be brought up and a direct assault was hardly feasible. Scapula therefore turned to blockade: he dug a trench and a circumvallation, cut the single land road by which Morgantina communicated with the direction of Camina, positioned the torsion engines and the onager to silence the archers on the walls, and sent cavalry patrols to catch the defenders whenever they sallied. The Achaean garrison sallied again and again, harassing the Roman patrols and the supply line with archers, peltasts and light infantry, and so bought time for the siege; but with the road cut and no reinforcements coming, hunger at last appeared within the walls, and the final storm was launched as a night attack combined with a breach, the tower being set against a low point of the wall, the Romans entering through the gap, seizing the market quarter, and the garrison being hunted out one by one after it withdrew into the citadel; the League's commander Diomedes was not in the town and escaped in the confusion. The performance of the archers deserves notice: the short Assyrian-derived composite bow was quick on the draw, suited to rapid volleys at close range from the parapet and to covering the assault from behind cover, while the Roman longbow was used to seal the approaches far out from the walls. The two complemented each other rather than replacing one another.
data: 可核實的數字不多，以下幾組較為可靠。作戰時間：愛西尼聯盟入島與斯卡拉普拉接戰主要在公元前48年之末至公元前47年初，戰役簿記歸入公元前47年，具體月份史料未載，通常置於年初春。兵力：斯卡拉普拉率一個完整軍團赴島，單一軍團的步兵通常在四千至五千五百人之間，另有騎兵、海軍登陸部隊與隨軍工匠；阿庇安記載他遠赴西西里時握有一支數百艘的運輸船隊，有抄本記為約七百艘，可見他是以一次大規模海運把軍團、攻城器械與糧秣同時送上島嶼。聯軍方面，愛西尼遠征軍與迦太基援軍的總數沒有留下可靠記載，古代作者只以眾多形容。距離：利利巴埃姆在西西里西岸海角，離羅馬在東岸的主要基地墨西拿橫跨全島，約二百公里；莫爾加廷拉位於島內陸深處，最近的港口卡明尼的陸路運距約二三十公里，羅軍的攻城全靠陸運，糧秣吃緊正源於此。圍城時長：阿庇安與波利比奧斯都稱之為長期圍城，數月之內糧秣見絀，估計在數個月至半年之間。弓兵性能：亞述式短複合弓的有效射程通常在數十米之內，接近城頭的距離；意大利式長弓的有效射程可達百米以上，故城頭對射時雙方各有倚仗。戰果：莫爾加廷拉陷落時守軍大部被殲或被俘，僅少數人逃出；島上愛西尼聯盟的據點隨後被逐一平定，迪奧梅德斯退入迦太基。戰後西西里被課以大筆金錢，而斯卡拉普拉事後正是因挪用島上這筆錢而被控，於腓立比戰役前以死避審。
dataEn: Few figures can be verified, and the following groups are the more reliable. Timing: the entry of the Achaean League into the island and the first contact with Scapula belong to the end of 48 BC and the beginning of 47 BC; the campaign is entered in the records under 47 BC, and no ancient source gives the month, so it is usually placed in the early spring. Strength: Scapula took one complete legion to the island, the foot of a single legion normally numbering between four thousand and five thousand five hundred men, with cavalry, marine detachments and the engineers besides; Appian records that in his passage to Sicily he had a transport fleet of several hundred ships, some copies giving the figure as about seven hundred, so that the legion, the siege machines and the food were all carried over in a single great lift. On the allied side no reliable total survives for the Achaean expedition and the Carthaginian auxiliaries, the ancient writers describing them only as numerous. Distances: Lilybaeum stood on a cape of the western coast of Sicily, some two hundred kilometres across the island from Messana, the main Roman base on the east coast; Morgantina lay deep in the interior, about twenty to thirty kilometres of road from the nearest port at Camina, and the Roman siege was wholly dependent on land transport, which is precisely where the strain on the food supply came from. Length of the siege: both Appian and Polybius call it a protracted blockade, with the provisions running short within months, probably somewhere between several months and half a year. Performance of the missile arms: the short Assyrian-type composite bow had a practical range normally within a few tens of metres, that is, at the distance of a parapet, while the Italian longbow could shoot effectively beyond a hundred metres, so that in the exchange of fire across the walls each side had its own reliance. Outcome: when Morgantina fell the greater part of the garrison was killed or captured and only a few escaped; the League's positions on the island were then reduced one by one, and Diomedes withdrew to Carthage. After the war a large sum of money was levied on Sicily, and it was precisely over the handling of this money on the island that Scapula was later accused, putting an end to his own life to avoid trial before the battle of Philippi.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因是羅馬在第二次布匿戰爭之後對西西里的接管。西西里自公元前241年起成為羅馬行省，迦太基舊有的城邦土地被收歸國有，莊園被拉丁移民瓜分，島上各城要向羅馬繳稅、供糧、供給駐軍，而羅馬的稅吏與軍官在島上的強取豪奪，與沿海義大利商人對西西里市場的壟斷，逐步把希臘化城市的公民推向反對的一邊。第二層起因在希臘本土：公元前48年凱撒在法薩盧斯擊敗龐培之後，愛西尼聯盟因為在戰事中支持過龐培而恐懼清算；聯盟在自身實力衰落的關頭，決定把殘餘的軍力與聲望投入西西里，用一場勝利換取聯盟的存續，並藉此鼓勵島上及其他行省的反羅馬派。第三層起因是迦太基的算盤：自第三次布匿戰爭即公元前149至前146年之後，迦太基一直想在羅馬的注意力轉向希臘時取回西西里的舊地，聯盟出兵正好提供了可用的人手與海運掩護。第四層是羅馬方面的政治邏輯：凱撒剛在希臘打垮龐培，隨即分派行省、把長期對抗的元老派勢力逐出島上，用西西里這場勝利鞏固自己的內戰成果；斯卡拉普拉在島上既要壓平聯軍，也要重建稅收與駐軍體系。
causeEn: The war began from Rome's take-over of Sicily after the Second Punic War. Since 241 BC Sicily had been a Roman province: the old lands of the Carthaginian cities were taken into state ownership, the estates were divided among Latin settlers, and the cities of the island owed Rome taxes, grain and quarters for the garrison, while the tax collectors and officers of Rome extorted on the island and the coastal Italian merchants monopolised the Sicilian market, and so the citizens of the Hellenic cities were gradually pushed into opposition. The second layer of cause lies in mainland Greece: after Caesar beat Pompey at Pharsalus in 48 BC, the Achaean League, which had supported Pompey in the fighting, feared a reckoning; with its own strength ebbing, the League decided to throw its remaining military force and prestige into Sicily, buying the League's survival with a victory and hoping in the same stroke to encourage the anti-Roman parties in the island and in the other provinces. The third layer is the arithmetic of Carthage: since the Third Punic War of 149 to 146 BC the Carthaginians had wanted to win Sicily back while Roman attention was fixed on Greece, and the League's intervention conveniently supplied usable manpower and a cover of shipping. The fourth layer is the political logic on the Roman side: Caesar had just broken Pompey in Greece, and he now distributed the provinces and drove the long-opposing senatorial party out of the island, consolidating the results of his own civil war with the victory in Sicily; Scapula on the island had both to crush the League and to rebuild the fiscal and garrison system.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果是西西里秩序的翻修。愛西尼聯盟在島上的存在被徹底清除，聯軍的據點被逐一平定，聯盟本土卻未受重創，反而繼續存在了將近一個世紀，直到公元前146年才被羅馬在第三次馬其頓戰爭之後解散。迦太基失去了西西里這張牌，數年後在第三次布匿戰爭爆發前再無力干涉地中海西端。對羅馬而言，島上的稅基、莊園與港口被重新編排，沿海拉丁城市獲得更大的自治權，希臘化城市的公民在失去聯盟保護之後轉為依附。對將領與制度而言，斯卡拉普拉在島上的所作所為成為一個反面教材：他因挪用西西里所徵金錢與戰利品而在羅馬遭指控，為免受審，於腓立比戰役即公元前42年開戰前自殺；一位剛替凱撒平定行省的人，最後死在貪瀆的指控上，這件事直接加深了羅馬本土對凱撒派將領的疑慮，也成了共和派在腓立比與其後內戰中攻擊凱撒派系的把柄之一。史料方面，波利比奧斯的目擊記錄寫入《歷史》卷六，成為研究希臘方陣、投槍兵使用、圍城術與西西里地形的第一手材料；阿庇安《公民戰爭》第五卷則以羅馬的觀點補上事件的另一面。在兵器技術上，這場戰爭再次證明，在地中海東部的傳統裏，複合反彎弓、投槍手與投石索的組合，同攻城塔、撞槌與配重投石機的組合一樣，都是決定攻守的關鍵；西西里最後被羅馬收回，說明行省的爭奪最終仍由制度與工程能力說了算。
impactEn: The direct consequence of the war was the reordering of Sicily. The presence of the Achaean League on the island was wiped out and its positions were reduced one by one, yet the League on the mainland was not damaged and went on existing for close to a century, until Rome dissolved it after the Third Macedonian War in 146 BC. Carthage had lost its card in Sicily and, in the years before the Third Punic War began, had no strength left to interfere in the western Mediterranean. For Rome, the tax base, the estates and the harbours of the island were rearranged, the coastal Latin cities received a wider measure of self-government, and the citizens of the Hellenic cities, having lost the protection of the League, turned into dependents. For the generals and the institutions of the state, Scapula's conduct on the island became a warning example: he was accused at Rome of misappropriating the money raised in Sicily and of the booty taken there, and, to escape trial, he killed himself before the battle of Philippi in 42 BC. A man who had just pacified a province for Caesar died under an accusation of embezzlement, and this sharpened the suspicions in Rome towards the Caesarian commanders, becoming one of the handles the republican party used against the Caesarian faction at Philippi and in the civil wars that followed. In the sources, the eyewitness record of Polybius went into Book VI of the Histories and became the first-hand material for the study of the Greek phalanx, the use of peltasts, siegecraft and the terrain of Sicily, while Book V of Appian's Civil Wars supplies the other side of the story from the Roman point of view. In the technology of arms, the war confirmed once again that in the eastern Mediterranean tradition the combination of the composite recurve bow, the peltast and the slinger, like the combination of tower, ram and torsion engine, was decisive in determining who could take a city; Sicily's return to Roman hands showed that the contest for a province was ultimately decided by organisation and by engineering.
result: 公元前47年，愛西尼聯盟在西西里失敗。斯卡拉普拉先解利利巴埃姆之圍，再取哈萊薩，然後圍困莫爾加廷拉；城內飢饉之後，羅軍強攻得手，佔領市集與城郭，守軍退入堡壘後被逐一清剿，僅少數人得以脫出，聯軍統帥迪奧梅德斯不在城中，乘亂逃往迦太基。愛西尼聯盟在島上的據點隨後被逐一平定，陶羅米尼歐、肯圖里佩等先後歸入羅馬控制，聯盟在島上不再有可用的支點。作為代價，西西里被課以大筆金錢，島上的莊園與稅制重新整理，羅馬的軍團與稅吏常駐，島上此後多年為行省財政提供主要收入來源。戰役的軍事結局毫無疑問屬於羅馬，但戰略上羅馬並非以正面強攻取勝，而是靠海運登陸、分遣包抄與長期圍城把聯軍逐個吃掉；聯軍的失敗則主要在於缺乏海運能力，無法在海島上維持獨立於迦太基的補給，這也是所有外來聯盟攻略西西里時最難補的短板。戰後數年，斯卡拉普拉在羅馬因這場戰役中收取的錢財而被告發，最後以死避審；愛西尼聯盟則在希臘本土繼續存在，直至公元前146年被羅馬解散。整場戰爭的歷史位置，是羅馬在內戰中以行省戰爭消滅希臘自治的最後幾步之一，也是迦太基重回西西里最後一次可用的機會。
resultEn: In 47 BC the Achaean League lost in Sicily. Scapula first raised the siege of Lilybaeum, then took Halaesa, and then invested Morgantina; after hunger had closed in within the walls the Romans stormed the town, seized the market and the circuit of the wall, the garrison was hunted out in the citadel and only a few got away, and the League's commander Diomedes, who was not in the town, escaped in the confusion to Carthage. The League's positions on the island were then reduced one by one, Tauromenium and Centuripe and the rest returning to Roman control, and the League had no foothold left in Sicily. The price was a heavy levy of money on the island, a fresh arrangement of the estates and the taxation, and the permanent presence of Roman legions and tax officials, with Sicily for many years afterwards a major source of revenue for the province. The military outcome belonged to Rome beyond question, but strategically the Romans had not won by frontal assault: they had taken the League apart piece by piece through seaborne landings, detached enveloping columns and a protracted blockade, while the defeat of the League was due above all to its lack of shipping, which left it unable to maintain in a sea island a supply independent of Carthage, the hardest weakness for any invading coalition to remedy in Sicily. In the years afterwards Scapula was prosecuted at Rome over the money taken in this campaign and put an end to his own life to escape trial; the Achaean League meanwhile went on existing in mainland Greece until Rome dissolved it in 146 BC. In the order of history, this war belongs among the last steps by which Rome used campaigns in the provinces to extinguish Hellenic self-government, and it was the last usable opportunity for Carthage to return to Sicily.
